reviews.text: Staff is always, friendly and professional. Care is always thorough. All were great! What they did best was a thorough exam, probed about pet's habits, and explanations.

Im giving these fine folks at Mt Airy 5 stars simply because they helped saved my animal. Packed with appointments, and me not being a regular patient, they took me in on a Friday afternoon as my pet was in trauma. They did everything they could to figure out the cause, coordinate paperwork with my regular vet, and find a solution. They saved my Larry. Dr Bernetti and the staff were excellent, and I'd recommend them to anyone. Thank you to this team

I’m beyond grateful for this place and need to express my deepest gratitude to Dr. Seymour and Vet Tech Paula for the exceptional care they provided to my cat, who recently passed away. Saying goodbye to a beloved pet is incredibly difficult, but their professionalism, comfort, and support during that process was truly unparalleled. Over the last 20 years, I have had wonderful experiences with all of the staff at Mt. Airy Animal Hospital, and it is clear that this entire team deeply cares for animals and their families ❤️🤗✨Thank you for all that you do!

Dr. Brunetti, did a phenomenal job taking care of our pet.  She was caring, professional, and thorough. Dr. Brunetti and Dr. Seymour are the main reasons we will continue to patronize M. Airy Animal Hospital.  Their staff are caring and helpful as well.

The team was fantastic. I was a little upset about Mr Cat, however the team was so patient and understanding . They were very pleasant and caring.  I will always leave Mr Cat in their care  All of the above, especially the Vet doctor and her assistant  Great staff
We have been steady clients here for years. The front office, techs, and doctors have all been wonderful with our pets.
Thank you for the 5-star review! We appreciate your support and are grateful you chose Mt. Airy Animal Hospital for your pet's care. We look forward to seeing you again soon.
They lovingly cared for my dog.
Excellent costumers services, doctors with high professionally, clean and safe place 😀
Dr. Lauderdale is excellent and very caring.  She took great care of little Georgie.  the visit with the doctor and care from the techs.

Very nice check in with staff at the front desk. It is quiet, clean and you can sit down in chairs in the waiting room that is small but okay . There is a TV to watch whatever is on. Your pet should be comfortable and mine usually is of tge small mix terrier breed. The vet doctors are nice and gentle with your dog if they maybe nervous or afraid.  The doctors explains everything if you have questions or concerns of anything of medication if needed and if the dog needs dental work. I will come back soon for my dog for  teeth cleaning.
I've always had a great experience with the staff and the vets for my various pets (dogs & cats) - it's convenient, clean and they're patient and kind to all. I love these guys.

Amazing! Friendly and supportive. The doctor was incredible and very supportive, the vet tech was very sweet and patient with our dog, and the front desk concierge was quick and helpful.  What they did best was be kind, supportive, and reasonably priced.
I enjoy the staff and office. Paola and Dr. Seymour are extremely personable and I love how they care for my fur babies when we visit.

I didn’t know I had a great vet until I urgently needed a great vet. Dr. Seymour squeezed us in when we were in crisis, and personally made several follow-up calls to make sure my fluff-ball’s health was trending in the right direction. The techs were also amazing, cooing over my dog and making him more at ease than he’s ever been at the vet before.

This is a no-frills clinic on the outside, but the level of care we received when we really needed it was next level.

Excellent! The staff is very kind. Dr. Seymour is smart, patient, extremely thorough and kind. She goes above and beyond for my pets and family at every visit. I trust her expertise 100% and recommend her to everyone!!
Thank you for the 5 stars! We strive to provide great care at a fair value, and we're glad that stood out during your visit.
Curtis, thank you for the 5 stars! Our team truly appreciates your support, and we look forward to seeing you and your pet again.

I am pleased so far with how my last appointment went, taking my cat in for a recent appetite issue. There has been appropriate followup as well, which is crucial because veterinary treatments and results can often stretch out beyond the initial appointment, and further communication and tasks are often needed-- and I'm happy to do my part in return as the human caregiver for my cat. I am extremely glad Jenny M. is the client liaison as well ---this is so generally helpful to get Rx approvals and messages to the vets, etc. She is the "glue" for the practice!
Everyone was very nice and efficient at this last appointment. The front desk people were great. So were the 2 vet techs.  Dr. Emily S. is really skilled, kind and patient, and shows love for our animals----- I hope she sticks around for a good long while!! [I've been coming to this practice with my various cats since 2007, and I so appreciate having a good general vet service in my local neighborhood--- it's such a needed asset!] What they have done best at Mt. Airy Animal Hospital is listen to all the relevant concerns for both my cat and myself as the 'pet parent,' and act accordingly.
The staff here is always so kind,loving and patient with my cat each and every time and we just want to say thank you
Always thorough and comprehensive care for every visit by the Veterinarian and the tech staff. Very satisfied!
We're glad you had a great experience and found our services to be a good value. We appreciate your support and look forward to caring for your pet in the future.
Very satisfied with the care and advice we received
i liked it. prices are higher than what i’m used to but still reasonable. support local vets!
Everyone seems knowledgeable and are professional. The staff is respectful and compassionate.
Dr. Seymour handled my appointment with care and kindness. Bruce is very sick and she kept me informed along the way while being kind and thoughtful.

Everyone at this office is so helpful.  The vet techs and veterinarian explained everything they were doing AND why.  Very helpful!
Front desk/checkout staff are polite, professional always have a smile!
Thanks for the 5 stars! It means a lot to our team, and we're glad we could be there for you and your pet. ❤️🐾 …
Always kind, professional. Been coming for over 30 years! Excellent care for my dogs and cats.
Excellent vet care! Dr. Emily Seymour is very thorough and warm. Easy to schedule and great communication.

Jessica was very attentive and gave helpful suggestions. Dr Lauderdale was also helpful cleaning my dog's ears when I didn't realize she had a potential problem with ear wax. I appreciated being able to get a Saturday appointment before we leave for vacation on Monday. In fact, our appointment was within an hour of me calling the office. Jessica (vet tech) and Dr. Lauderdale were wonderful. Helpful, empathetic.

I am extremely confident in the care provided to Sadie. The tech who did the intake for Sadie show tremendous compassion and attentiveness to my Sadie and to myself. You can see her love for the pets. All went well from check in to departure. The tech was very attentive and the doctor was thorough and kind.
Wonderful ! Staff very caring !
The vet and vet tech were kind and personable and thorough with their questions. They arranged a follow up call to check on my cats status and followed through as presented.
Excellent Veterinary Hospital with a knowledgeable staff and very caring doctors.

My veterinarian retired, and I just went to Mt Airy Animal Hospital for my first appointment with my older cat ……he is 20! I was thoroughly pleased by the care and compassion my cat received. It was thorough, informative, and helpful. I definitely will continue to go to Mt Airy Animal Hospital. I would recommend their services to anyone seeking quality animal care and treatment.
It was great!!!

We really appreciate your feedback, Danielle—thank you!
Keeping care accessible and fair is important to us, and we’re glad that stood out to you.

Very good visit with Dr. Seymour. I was able to ask about issues with my dog's behavior during her annual checkup. I felt comfortable asking about treatments and my dog was very happy with her checkup. Admin and techs all friendly and helpful. Everyone - front desk, intake tech, the doctor, dog-holding tech - did a great job. We're grateful for their kindness and professionalism.

Dr. Lauderdale and team were so helpful earlier this year in quickly diagnosing our cat, and referred us to a nearby emergency pet hospital for care, which saved our cat! They are kind, professional and action-oriented, and Jenny from the Mt. Airy team followed up often to check in on how he was doing, answered all of my questions and provided guidance for aftercare. We are so grateful! Thank you SO MUCH for everything. Your compassion and follow up care is so appreciated, to this day. He is doing great months later, and I thank you and Dr. Lauderdale so much. Dr. Lauderdale and Jenny's coordination, along with the hospital was so helpful and reassuring during a scary time.

It was exceptional. The team worked very hard to treat my extra anxious little guy. They went above and beyond. Both Dr. Seymour and Vet Tech Paula were heroes in our book. Their kindness and care meant so much. What they did best was to personalize the care they provided to my dog. They assessed his challenges and demeanor and worked very hard and creatively to make him comfortable. HUGE success.
Wonderful care provided by techs and Dr Seymour.
This place is amazing my dog wasn't breathing well i was turned away by other hospitals.But this hospital saved my dog life.I greatly appreciate everything they done for my dog, chicago.
Thank you so much for the 5 stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ We really appreciate the support and are glad you had a great experience with us. It means a lot to our whole team!

I was extremely happy with the care Rory had been given while she was with you. Everyone was very sweet with Rory. I felt thoroughly informed about what would take place before the surgery as well as immediately following the surgery and left confident in knowing what Rory's aftercare needs would be. Olivia was amazing! She was kind and helpful in all interactions I had with her. Because of my own issues, I was unable to carry Rory out to the car when sedated after surgery. Olivia offered to carry her out for me immediately!
< br /> What they did best was inspire confidence in knowing Rory was in the best possible hands.

The Vet Tech was very caring and knowledgeable. Victoria helped to explain the procedure when a microchipped pet is found and she was great with my kitty, Stevie. Dr. Lauderdale was wonderful as well. They explained to me all of my options while I am waiting to see if Stevie's original owner chooses to claim him. Victoria was amazing! She was great with Stevie and did her due diligence in finding out if he had a prior owner and explaining not only her processes, abut also explaining what was happening as I was waiting. She has great bedside manner. What they did best was the clear communication every step of the way. i was very impressed by that and their empathy and care.
Great staff. Overall they did an awesome job 😊
They’re the best. Nothing else to say. 🐈😺 …

Excellent service . FIRST visit was today.
He was so happy when he came out.

The Staff is wonderful. Really treated my fur baby  BLUE so well. Very professional.
I highly recommend them.

Office folks are Friendly and helpful. I was able to get an appointment and surgery the same day for my dog, who fractured her nail while running the trails. The technicians and doctors are knowledgeable and empathetic. Thank you for taking care of my doggo!

Prompt and caring service by techs for blood work and nail trim (cat). All staff, from the front desk, vet techs and assistant, and the vet provide excellent care and service. Mt Airy Animal Hospital provides prompt and quality care for a very reasonable cost.
11/10 always a great experience. I never feel like a number coming in and out. I appreciate the kind and loving care my babies receive from everyone.
My purrfect feline was handled with so much care and love. I appreciate the advice they gave us and their availability. They were a big help.

Thank you so much, Tiffany, for the 5‑star rating! ⭐ We truly appreciate your support and trust in our team. It means a lot to us, and we’re grateful for the opportunity to care for you and your pet. We look forward to seeing you again at Mt Airy Animal Hospital! 🐾💙 …
Scheduling was easy, they took good care of my cat, and they checked in afterwards (via text) to make sure he was doing okay.

Caring, knowledgeable, and professional Animal Hospital! Definitely our experience with Dr. Emily Seymore and the staff is why we truly value Mt. Airy Animal Hospital. Overall the whole experience is top notch! Excellent doc and staff and always a compassionate approach. Highly recommend

This was our second time seeing Dr. Seymour and I as well as my dog love her. She is so personable and down to earth and she greeted my dog by crouching down to his level which made him feel comfortable and she was able to perform her exam seamlessly. She is a great asset to the practice.
Extremely satisfied All staff are great Care of pets, familiarity, price break down, empathy, and great customer service skills

Thank you so much for the 5‑star rating, Faith! We truly appreciate you taking the time to support our team. We’re grateful for your trust and look forward to caring for you and your pets again!

The Staff Of Mt Airy Animal Hospital
Staff is efficient and they are gentle with handling your animals
Always very professional and warm.

Ive been going to Mt Airy Hospital since 2009 I believe..all of my cats I gad or have now have been compassionately and generously taken care of by the staff there.
Dr Lauderdale and Dr Emily Seymour and a previous doctor are my cats' pet favorites. There was a male vet who was very vivacious and engaging with my cats too. This doctor had health problems...no longer at Mt Airy Animal Hospital. He would get on the floor and play with my male cat.
The veterinarians there truly care and are professional and knowledgeable.  They have been there and helped my cats and me financially able to pay for my pets car e with carecredit, cherry.com and payment arrangements once in a while. They given so must compassion to me and all my cats over the years that shown me how to reciprocate love and compassion to all the strays and rescue I  feed and care for. Presently Im caring for 12 strays in east Mt Airy and my own two at home. Im just so grateful for the doctors and staff at Mt Airy Animal Hospital in Philadelphia. 5 stars is the highest I can rate them but if there was a 10 I would give them that. Thank yall from the bottom of my heart and my 2 rescue cats as well.
C. Ferguson
Wait time is short, service is friendly. Been taking my animals (cats and dogs) here for years and communication has always been clear and the vets and techs seem to really care.
Quality care for my cats, no issues encountered.
The staff at Mt. Airy Hospital are the best. They are patient and friendly. I appreciate the care Princess receives here.
Almost no one gets 5 stars on anything.  I like this hospital because the staff excel in compassion, effectiveness, knowledge, communications, price, appointment making, hours open.
Excellent care and empathy for our dog. Dr. Burnetti explained everything well and took her time with us and our pup. The entire staff was helpful and friendly.
Everyone was so helpful and kind, and Bela (who is normally nervous at vet offices) was at ease. Thank you!!

Hi there,
We’re sorry to see your 1‑star review, and we’d really like to understand what went wrong. Since no comments were left, we’re not sure what your experience was or how we can make it right.
Your feedback is important to us, and we truly want every visit to be a positive one. If you’re willing, please reach out to us directly at 215-248-1886 and ask for the hospital administrator so we can learn more and address any concerns you may have.
Thank you for taking the time to let us know something didn’t meet expectations — we hope to have the chance to improve your experience.
The Mt. Airy Animal Hospital Team
Amazing team and really loving to our girl Violet!  Dr Seymour was lovely and her nurse was fantastic!  Great that they are in the neighborhood
the nurse and the vet were both very kind and communicative . We have a rescue that has issues and they were very helpful in getting us on the right path

Thank you so much for the 5‑star rating! We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your support. It means a lot to our team to know we’re providing a positive experience, and we’re grateful for the trust you place in us to care for your pet.
Warm regards,
The Mt. Airy Animal Hospital Staff

Our cats always get terrific care at Mt. Airy Animal Hospital, and we love Dr. Brunetti and Dr. Lauderdale. They take their time with both us and the cats and explain everything clearly. The vet techs are all great, too. And the follow-ups by Jenny are amazing!
The care team is professional, caring and timely.

I don't know why anyone would go here. Complete waste of time. Long on attitude while short on service.
Good Luck.

I have a 15 year old spaniel mix who has had recurring urinary tract and ear infections.over the last couple of years.
I decided to take her to this clinic to see if they suggested different treatments.They asked me to bring in a urine sample which
I did and while i was there they took a blood sample.
They suggested basically the same treatment but also mentioned a possible x-ray which would have added $165 to the bill.
Since I had not gotten a blood test before I decided to go with the ear cleaning,urine test and blood work first before getting an x-ray. At least that was what I thought was agreed upon.
I thanked the technician before I left for administering the ear drops  whereupon she said that she hadn’t in fact done so! The vet made a remark about “crossed wires” and put the drops in herself.
I waited for them to call me with the results of the blood and urine analysis and when several days had passed with no call from them, I called on the following Monday.The young man who answered the phone could not find any results and said the vet would call me which she did. I then discovered that though I had brought in a sample and blood had been drawn, no tests had been performed!
In short, if I hadn’t mentioned the ear drops, I would have left with only a sanitary groom { for which they charged triple the amount charged by my usual vet), ear cleaning and prescriptions .the charge for this was $320 ! The same service performed by my usual Vet , INCLUDING urine analysis is $240.
I have never written a negative review of a business but I cannot recommend this Practice and will not be returning.

I was very happy with the care Sweet Pea received. I noticed how gently each person treated her, and how calmly she seemed while being touched by so many people. Dr Seymour was wonderful, and Sweet Pea seemed content with her.
< br />I also appreciated the recommendations made weren't excessive; meaning I didn't feel like it was a guessing game involving medications and treatments thst may not be needed.
< br />I also felt respected and heard. Dr Seymour, I have never seen Sweet Pea that comfortable with someone she just met. I really appreciate your relaxed approach about Sweet Pea's care, and ruling out unnecessary treatments until they may be needed. Also, Thank you for letting me know that I can reach out to you if/when I may need to. It proves you care about your patients and their humans :) What I appreciated most is hard to say. The respect, compassion, clarity, knowledge were all wonderful!

Friendly, helpful, thorough and convenient Vet Assistant and Veterinarian! I am sorry I don't recall their names- it was the first time I saw them. Eve Harbison visit on 1/16 at 2:20 pm What I appreciated most is the kindness and thoroughness of the staff
everything and everyone was great,

Dr Seymore and everyone on staff were very attentive and always answer phone questions thoroughly. The front desk staff and techs were so friendly and put us at ease which was very much needed when dealing with a sick pup. We have been going here for years and they are always very friendly.
Dr. Brunetti is awesome! The technicians took great care of us & we got all of our questions answered. The front desk concierge was really friendly and welcoming. Would definitely recommend
The staff were all so caring, professional and kind. They treated my pet like one of their own.

As always, the team was highly professional, and extremely thorough Dr Lauderdale is the ABSOLUTE bomb! The whole family loves her! What I appreciated most is ease of dealing with the practice and the professionalism of the staff

The care I received was truly exceptional from start to finish. Dr. Brunetti was kind, patient, and incredibly knowledgeable, and it was clear from the very first moment that she genuinely cares about her patients. She went above and beyond to save my kitten’s life, showing compassion and dedication. I am beyond grateful for everything she did, and I cannot recommend her highly enough. She is an extraordinary veterinarian and an absolute blessing to both pets and their owners.

Ace has been to Mt Airy animal hospital 2x now, once for his first visit & checkup, and again to be neutered & get his second round of vaccines. The staff seem to care about the pets that come in and Ace was comfortable & happy when I picked him up post surgery. Everyone there is super nice, helpful, and willing to shift/add on things like vaccines, teeth cleanings, etc to avoid multiple visits.

I told my vet how to handle my dog, and she did exactly the opposite of what I said. On the drive home, my dog was clearly stressed out from the amount of panting he was doing. My dog typically rolls onto his back for belly rubs at the vet, and every vet has told me how good of a boy he is after the appointment. I do not recommend this animal hospital.

I have been using this practice for shots/ checkups since moving to Mt. Airy. Always had a nice experience. Last week we took our boy in very last minute when he started acting lethargic out of the blue. Dr. Emily was incredible and walked my partner through everything that was going on with him. She even gave us her phone number so that we could contact her after business hours (seeing as I was at work during the appointment and had questions when I arrived home.)  After speaking with her again later that evening- we made the decision to take him down to Penn. They verified everything she had said ( and were able to run a few more diagnostics that she was not able to do with her equipment in office) and helped us peacefully put him to rest. I am so grateful to her and the rest of the vets/ team members who helped us that evening. Dr. Seymour was both intelligent and incredibly compassionate. I am glad our boy didn’t have to suffer for very long. Thank you 🥹
Wonderful team. Everyone is knowledgeable and warm. They take weekend appointments. The best.

Dropping initial review from 2018 from 4 to 1 stars.  This place has sadly really gone downhill.  There seems to be only 1 full-time veterinarian, and the rest are fill-ins from other places.  This leads to a horrible discontinuity of information, which is exacerbated by staff not reading case notes and or not really caring.

Within the last year we had a medical issue with one of our pets and every single time we'd go in we'd have to start from the beginning.  Vet A would tell us to schedule for 2 weeks for follow up, we'd go in, get Vet B and they'd have no idea why we were there.  After multiple visits over a few months to get the pet's medication where they suggested it became radio silence.  They never once contacted to follow up or see how the pet was doing, or for follow up blood work to see if the medication levels were correct.  So after almost 20 years of being clients here we were done and moved to a new vet.

Also some general issues - forget about appointment times.  If your appointment is at 10am they might take you back by 10:15, but you'll likely be standing in there with your pet for another 30 minutes before someone comes in.  Multiple times I've had to stick my head through the door into the vet area to see if anyone even knew we were waiting or if they had forgotten about us.  And after many (many) requests to use my wife's cell phone as the primary contact, they'd still - every single time - use mine.  Not sure if that's their system or the "I just don't care" attitude by the counter staff.

Would like to thank Dr Crystal Lauderdale and the team at Mt Airy Animal Hospital for the wonderful care provided to my beloved son Frankie as well as my daughter Ladygirl back in the 90's. Always treated with respect here with excellent advice, careful well thought out plans of action, and care. Today I  received a sympathy card from Mt Airy Animal Hospital regarding the recent passing of Frankie who was a very trust worthy member of my family for over 20 years, including being right by my side and sleeping across my lap during the Phillies World Series in 2008 and during 2 Super Bowl wins with the Eagles in 2018 and 2025. He was also loved most recently by my granddaughter who loved to give him hugs and lay side by side with him.

For many years, we had our six cats and one dog cared for by Mt. Airy, and always experienced superior work on our four legged family members' behalf, incredible compassion for them, and genuinely demonstrated courtesy to our two legged family members.  Sadly we relocated too far away in 2018 to continue with Mt. Airy. In 2025, as we struggled with how best to care for our one surviving but failing cat, and frustrated at the input I was receiving elsewhere, I thought to call Dr. Lauderdale who had always exemplified the very very best one could hope to have in a vet. She is simply incomparable!  I was not sure she would call this old patient after seven years but she did return my call the very next day and devoted much time to discussing our little guy's symptoms and habits in order to offer her best judgment about how to assess him and when to make that very difficult decision.  I ask: how many vets would do the same?  I cannot more highly recommend Mt. Airy whose entire staff always performed so well!
Dr Emily is the reason we drive a hour to go here.
Super friendly staff and excellent vet!
Staff was friendly and helpful.

After waiting with my highly anxious large pit mix dog and my very anxious cat for 40 minutes after our appointment time, I cancelled and walked out. It’s not the first time I have waited 30 plus minutes after my appointment to be seen. They seem to always run late. I try to then only bring the dog or cat and myself but couldn’t this time (needed annual vaccinations for boarding so brought everyone.) We then are going to have to find other veterinarian as I’m done.

Vets were great and booking was a breeze. Only dinged one star because of a pervasive "doggy odor" (which may be hard to avoid in an older building) that probably didn't help an already stressed-out cat.

I love the care this staff provides for my cat and small dog! Dr. Crystal Lauderdale is kind, supportive,  patient of course knowledge and know how to impart that knowledge to her human animal parents!

My experience at mount airy animal hospital deserves a 1 star in my opinion! The Doctor was not very compassionate with the care of my cat.  He was there to have bloodwork. And I heard her say under her breath that my cat was loaded with fleas, and yet she never gave me any treatment advice or anything. I felt that crystal was very disconnected. Won't be going back there again!

I have been a patron for years with different Drs. There is a change over problem!! Everyone seems to dodge dr Lauderdale Today!!! Well last week, I booked an appointment for my reactive dog, asking for male to be present last week. Appt was Tuesday at 3pm. Got a call on Monday saying a male would not be there and to reschedule for today, Wednesday 8/13/25. I was given time slots, I chose 5pm. My dog is a 110lb pit rescue, I let him be Himself!!  (Last visit it was only women there that couldn’t get blood work cause they couldn’t hold him) so I’d have to pay another dr. Visit fee cause they couldn’t!!! Fee would have to happen because techs were women and so was the interim Dr who asked me to get on the floor during the visit and Still Pay Her!! Mind you I’m paying nothing under $250! It was disrespectful how she said it and complexions. Nonetheless, paid Dr fee but my boy didn’t get bloodwork done. Scandal!!! Anywho, today was Awful!! I come in 45 minutes after their rescheduled time, sitting in the parking lot, calling them, feeling like I’m getting on their nerves in a THUNDERSTORM!! Still thinking they are prepared for my dog that needs a man and am told it’s just women !! And Dr Lauderdale who I didn’t want to see!! (She did good today) yet, the tech told me the men were gone at 5pm appt. I WAS Called by YALL to reschedule for A Man that could handle my dog!! Time slots were offered and I chose and I chose this, yet I had a 3pm appt the day before. She was argumentative, hostile and I am questioning the way she handled my animal. Loved  this place but now my Roscoe is good til September 2026, it gives me time to to find another place. I NO longer trust Mt. Airy Hospital with the Health of my animal. I hate that I Approve This Message!!

This is a very poorly run vet clinic that is rapidly going downhill. It is not very clean or pleasant, and the front desk staff is unfriendly and unwelcoming. It is the type of place where people avoid making eye contact when you have a question or a problem. Culture.

I just walked out after sitting in the lobby for 30 minutes with my sick dog without anyone even talking to me. We have been customers for 2 years, and I just can't take it anymore.
Best place in town for pets.I had have a dog and I had a cat.I had to put my cat of nineteen years down.They were so gentle, so kind, and they followed up.Wonderful place

Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review!
We’re truly grateful and thrilled to hear that you had a positive experience at our animal hospital. Our team is dedicated to providing compassionate, high-quality care to every pet that walks through our doors, and it means the world to know we made a difference for you and your furry family member.
We look forward to seeing you both again soon!

Took my dog there on May 23 2025  for wellness check and have her anal sacks busted they never  did it my dog  Bella got real sick June 9 2025 called the clinic they said  I'd get a call back it never  happened and I paid these people 237.00 .I want back what they charge me to bust anal sack. And I'm looking for another  vet.

I really wanted to like this vet because it's close to my house and there seems to be not a ton of vets/groomers etc in this area. I brought in a cat that's my neighbors cat that she has asked me to take on as she can no longer care for it. I wanted to make sure the cat was healthy first so I brought him here.

After they brought us to the back the gentlemen went over options for vaccinating the cat etc. This was a waste of time as the cat was getting more and more anxious having been taken to the vet by a stranger and i already discussed this over the phone. Right before they were about to evaluate the cat an emergency came in and the tech informed me I would have to wait while they take care of the emergency. I said " really but I don't want to sit here forever it's not my cat and it's freaking out" to which the guy said well sorry and walked away.

40 mins later the cat is now fully hissing and loosing it's mind. I coax it back into the carrier as I intended to leave and this is when the vet finally returns. (A new vet briefly stepped in to make me repeat myself as to why I am there for the 3rd time. Then she left for 5 minutes to get a towel.) When they finally were ready to examine the cat it was in full freak out mode and they had to hold it down and wrestle with it. This seemed overly cruel. They then gave the cat back to me blaming the cat saying it needs meds for vet visits.  Lady your office stressed both of us out. Very unprofessional almost an hour in total when the exam took 10 mins.

Editing to add that I would never ever ever bring my dog here. The staff was indifferent at best. But thanks for the response.

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! 🌟 We're thrilled to hear that you had a positive experience at our veterinary office. Your support means a lot to us, and we're here to provide the best care for your pets. If you ever need anything or have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out. Thanks again for your kind rating! 🐾😊 …

Thank you for your wonderful 5-star review! 🌟 We're delighted to know that you had a great experience with your pets care at our veterinary office. Your positive feedback motivates us to continue providing excellent care for your pets. If you ever need assistance or have any questions, feel free to reach out. We appreciate your support! 🐾😊

.Dr. Niggermeyer, although knowledgeable is very unprofessional. If you ask too many questions she gets on defense , becomes angry and very disrespectful. She sees nothing wrong with her immature ways and the owner doesn't care to address her actions . The owner Hakim pretends to care but is not very caring or compassionate and doesn't care to improve the services. Jenny the manager is phenomenal and is very kind professional, caring and compassionate. She is only reason I stayed with this office . However, the disrespect shown to me and lack of concern for my diabetic cat has caused a separation that was long overdue.

Very Professional.
